projectDescription: A .NET CLI tool that scrapes JW.ORG to discover and bulk-download Enjoy Life video publications in multiple languages and resolutions.
keyFeatures: Interactive CLI prompts powered by Spectre.Console for language, section, resolution, and output directory selection
Multi-language support via a configurable config.json file mapping languages to JW.ORG section URLs
Parallel scraping with configurable concurrency (up to 8 threads) for fast HTML and JSON extraction
Two video file naming modes: JW Library-compatible names or simple human-readable titles
Two file organization modes: flat directory or section-grouped subdirectories
Disk-based caching of scraped HTML, JSON responses, and downloaded videos to avoid redundant network requests
Multiple resolution support (3GP, 240p, 360p, 480p, 720p) with estimated total download size shown before selection
Single-file executable publishing via .NET 9 PublishSingleFile for easy distribution
publicApiSurface: IWebScraper.DownloadAllFiles(sectionUrls, resolution, targetDir, fileNameType, filePathType, callback)
IFileService.WriteAllText / ReadAllText / Exists / Create / GetFileData / CreateDirectory
